name: Ousaka Kanae
source: "Every road leads to eroticism. Giving it your everything is wonderful. Pure love? What's that? Something delicious?"Wataru's upperclassman who is part of the literature course and is very mischievous. Kanae is a semi-professional writer already, but she doesn't have enough content to write pure love novels. Whenever she has a writer's block, she dreams about her dormmates in kinky and perverted situations.
